# Dawid Olko

> Dawid Olko is a Fullstack / AI Developer from Rzeszów, Poland. Selected work, tech stack, CV, experience and the Skribly ecosystem.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://portfolio.dawidolko.pl/): Profile, selected work, experience and tech stack.
- [Skribly](https://portfolio.dawidolko.pl/skribly/): Skribly is a private, non-commercial project of five developers from Rzeszów: a family of developer tools for planning work and building software with AI coding agents.
